svg.title: Robinson annulation: E1cB dehydration
svg.desc: Bicyclic enolate bearing beta-OH → Fused bicyclic enone (octalone) + OH−. Enolate donation makes the alpha/beta alkene as C–OH cleaves. Original carbonyl oxygen leaves with hydroxide; the side-chain-derived ketone is retained.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
